WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    request,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,local_operator_id}', request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,book_id}', request->>'book_id')::uuid END AS book_id,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,l1a_unit_id}', request->>'l1a_unit_id') ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN COALESCE(request #>> '{scope,l1a_unit_id}', request->>'l1a_unit_id')::uuid END AS requested_l1a_unit_id
  FROM input
), scoped AS (
  SELECT n.*, bp.id AS scoped_book_id, bp.current_l1a_id
  FROM normalized AS n
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = n.book_id
   AND bp.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
), candidate AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    selected.candidate_version_id,
    selected.candidate_book_id,
    selected.candidate_chapter_id,
    selected.predecessor_version_id,
    selected.deduction_locked,
    selected.candidate_plot_sim_json,
    selected.candidate_truth_ledger,
    selected.candidate_truth_ledger_valid,
    selected.target_snapshot_json,
    selected.chapter_implementation_json,
    selected.deduction_progress_json,
    selected.prose_text,
    selected.exception_summary_jsonb,
    selected.current_chapter_id,
    selected.current_chapter_index,
    selected.current_chapter_id IS NOT NULL AS ordered_next_candidate,
    (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.audit_attempt_log AS attempt
      WHERE attempt.book_id = selected.candidate_book_id
        AND attempt.chapter_id = selected.candidate_chapter_id
        AND attempt.chapter_version_id = selected.candidate_version_id
        AND attempt.audit_type = 'objective'
        AND attempt.audit_status = 'completed'
        AND attempt.is_valid
        AND NOT attempt.is_shadow) AS objective_attempt_count
  FROM scoped AS s
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      cv.id AS candidate_version_id,
      cv.book_id AS candidate_book_id,
      cv.chapter_id AS candidate_chapter_id,
      cv.predecessor_version_id,
      cv.deduction_locked,
      cv.candidate_plot_sim_json,
      cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger' AS candidate_truth_ledger,
      (
        jsonb_typeof(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger') = 'object'
        AND (cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger') ?& ARRAY[
          'schema_version', 'world_changes', 'character_live_state_changes', 'relation_changes', 'memories'
        ]
        AND cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger'->>'schema_version' = '1'
        AND jsonb_typeof(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger'->'world_changes') = 'array'
        AND jsonb_typeof(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger'->'character_live_state_changes') = 'array'
        AND jsonb_typeof(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger'->'relation_changes') = 'array'
        AND jsonb_typeof(cv.candidate_plot_sim_json->'candidate_truth_ledger'->'memories') = 'array'
      ) AS candidate_truth_ledger_valid,
      cv.target_snapshot_json,
      cv.chapter_implementation_json,
      cv.deduction_progress_json,
      cv.prose_text,
      cv.exception_summary_jsonb,
      h.id AS current_chapter_id,
      h.chapter_index AS current_chapter_index
    FROM public.chapter_header AS h
    JOIN public.chapter_version AS cv
      ON cv.chapter_id = h.id
     AND cv.book_id = h.book_id
     AND cv.version_state = 'candidate'
     AND cv.deduction_locked
     AND cv.is_valid
     AND NOT cv.is_shadow
    WHERE h.book_id = s.scoped_book_id
      AND h.l1a_unit_id = s.requested_l1a_unit_id
      AND h.l1a_unit_id = s.current_l1a_id
      AND NOT h.is_finalized
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.chapter_header AS previous_chapter
        WHERE previous_chapter.book_id = s.scoped_book_id
          AND previous_chapter.l1a_unit_id = s.requested_l1a_unit_id
          AND previous_chapter.chapter_index < h.chapter_index
          AND previous_chapter.confirmation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'creator_confirmed'
      )
    ORDER BY h.chapter_index, cv.version_no DESC, cv.id
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS selected ON true
), audit_context AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'title', bp.title,
      'genre_main', bp.genre_main,
      'intent_json', bp.intent_json,
      'forbid_json', bp.forbid_json,
      'selling_points_json', bp.selling_points_json,
      'chapter_words', bp.chapter_words,
      'presentation_intensity', bp.presentation_intensity
    ) AS book_context,
    COALESCE(world.world_state_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS world_state_json,
    COALESCE(characters.character_profiles_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS character_profiles_json,
    COALESCE(relations.relation_state_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS relation_state_json,
    COALESCE(memories.formal_memory_json, '[]'::jsonb) AS formal_memory_json,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'world_states', COALESCE(world.world_state_json, '[]'::jsonb),
      'character_live_states', COALESCE(characters.character_profiles_json, '[]'::jsonb),
      'relation_states', COALESCE(relations.relation_state_json, '[]'::jsonb),
      'memories', COALESCE(memories.formal_memory_json, '[]'::jsonb)
    ) AS formal_state_baseline_json,
    COALESCE(future_commitments.locked_future_l1a_commitments, '[]'::jsonb) AS locked_future_l1a_commitments,
    previous_formal.prose_text AS previous_formal_prose_text,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(rewrite_instruction.force_manual, false)
      THEN NULL ELSE rewrite_instruction.fix_instruction_json END AS fix_instruction_json,
    (COALESCE(rewrite_instruction.force_manual, false)
      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(c.deduction_progress_json->>'reject_count', '')::integer, 0) >= 3) AS editorial_retry_limit_reached
  FROM candidate AS c
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = c.scoped_book_id
   AND bp.local_operator_id = c.local_operator_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'world_state_id', ws.id,
        'board_type', ws.board_type,
        'atom_type', ws.atom_type,
        'atom_key', ws.atom_key,
        'atom_value_jsonb', ws.atom_value_jsonb,
        'affordance_dims', ws.affordance_dims,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', ws.knowledge_boundary_json,
        'apply_scope_json', ws.apply_scope_json,
        'violate_cost_json', ws.violate_cost_json
      ) ORDER BY ws.board_type, ws.atom_key, ws.id
    ) AS world_state_json
    FROM public.world_state AS ws
    WHERE ws.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND ws.setting_layer = 'initial'
      AND ws.is_active
      AND ws.is_formal
      AND ws.is_valid
      AND NOT ws.is_shadow
  ) AS world ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', character.id,
        'char_name', character.char_name,
        'char_type', character.char_type,
        'char_code', character.char_code,
        'five_layers_json', character.five_layers_json,
        'knowledge_boundary_json', character.knowledge_boundary_json,
        'arc_json', character.arc_json,
        'conflict_seed_json', character.conflict_seed_json,
        'live_state_id', character.live_state_id,
        'philosophy_live_json', character.philosophy_live_json,
        'emotion_state_json', character.emotion_state_json,
        'drive_live_json', character.drive_live_json,
        'trigger_state_json', character.trigger_state_json,
        'goal_state_json', character.goal_state_json,
        'pressure_level', character.pressure_level,
        'current_goal_txt', character.current_goal_txt,
        'current_emo_tag', character.current_emo_tag
      ) ORDER BY character.char_code, character.id
    ) AS character_profiles_json
    FROM public.v_character_active AS character
    WHERE character.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND character.is_active
      AND character.is_formal
      AND character.is_valid
      AND NOT character.is_shadow
  ) AS characters ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'relation_state_id', relation.id,
        'char_a_id', relation.char_a_id,
        'char_b_id', relation.char_b_id,
        'before', jsonb_build_object(
          'trust', relation.trust,
          'intimacy', relation.intimacy,
          'power_balance', relation.power_balance,
          'dependence', relation.dependence,
          'hostility', relation.hostility,
          'common_goal', relation.common_goal,
          'secret_known', relation.secret_known,
          'emotional_bond', relation.emotional_bond,
          'relation_type', relation.relation_type,
          'relation_hierarchy', relation.relation_hierarchy,
          'relation_origin', relation.relation_origin,
          'relation_overview', relation.relation_overview,
          'change_event_json', relation.change_event_json
        )
      ) ORDER BY relation.char_a_id, relation.char_b_id, relation.id
    ) AS relation_state_json
    FROM public.relation_state AS relation
    WHERE relation.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND relation.is_formal
      AND relation.is_valid
      AND NOT relation.is_shadow
  ) AS relations ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'memory_id', memory.id,
        'character_id', memory.char_id,
        'chapter_id', memory.chapter_id,
        'chapter_version_id', memory.chapter_version_id,
        'memory_type', memory.memory_type,
        'memory_content', memory.memory_content,
        'truth_status', memory.truth_status,
        'importance', memory.importance,
        'decay_rate', memory.decay_rate
      ) ORDER BY memory.created_at, memory.id
    ) AS formal_memory_json
    FROM public.character_memory AS memory
    WHERE memory.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND memory.is_valid
      AND NOT memory.is_shadow
      AND (
        memory.chapter_version_id IS NULL
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.chapter_version AS memory_version
          WHERE memory_version.id = memory.chapter_version_id
            AND memory_version.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
            AND memory_version.version_state = 'formal'
            AND memory_version.is_formal
            AND memory_version.is_valid
            AND NOT memory_version.is_shadow
        )
      )
  ) AS memories ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'l1a_id', future_l1a.id,
        'l1a_index', future_l1a.l1a_index,
        'l1a_name', future_l1a.l1a_name,
        'chapter_nos_json', future_l1a.chapter_nos_json,
        'conflict_background', future_l1a.conflict_background,
        'escalation_path', future_l1a.escalation_path,
        'stakes', future_l1a.stakes,
        'irreversible_consequence', future_l1a.irreversible_consequence,
        'plot_emotion_commit', future_l1a.plot_emotion_commit,
        'arc_requirement', future_l1a.arc_requirement,
        'info_reveal_boundary', future_l1a.info_reveal_boundary,
        'role_arc_json', future_l1a.role_arc_json
      ) ORDER BY future_l1a.l1a_index, future_l1a.id
    ) AS locked_future_l1a_commitments
    FROM public.l1a_unit AS current_l1a
    JOIN public.l1a_unit AS future_l1a
      ON future_l1a.book_id = current_l1a.book_id
     AND future_l1a.l1a_index >= current_l1a.l1a_index
     AND future_l1a.confirmation_status = 'creator_confirmed'
     AND future_l1a.is_locked
     AND future_l1a.is_formal
     AND future_l1a.is_valid
     AND NOT future_l1a.is_shadow
    WHERE current_l1a.id = c.current_l1a_id
      AND current_l1a.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND current_l1a.is_valid
      AND NOT current_l1a.is_shadow
  ) AS future_commitments ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT previous_version.prose_text
    FROM public.chapter_header AS previous_header
    JOIN public.chapter_version AS previous_version
      ON previous_version.chapter_id = previous_header.id
     AND previous_version.book_id = previous_header.book_id
     AND previous_version.version_state = 'formal'
     AND previous_version.is_formal
     AND previous_version.is_valid
     AND NOT previous_version.is_shadow
    WHERE previous_header.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND previous_header.chapter_index < c.current_chapter_index
    ORDER BY previous_header.chapter_index DESC, previous_version.version_no DESC, previous_version.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS previous_formal ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      editor.fix_instruction_json,
      COALESCE((editor.decision_json->>'force_manual')::boolean, false) AS force_manual
    FROM public.editor_log AS editor
    WHERE editor.book_id = c.scoped_book_id
      AND editor.chapter_id = c.candidate_chapter_id
      AND editor.chapter_version_id = c.candidate_version_id
      AND editor.phase = 'editorial'
      AND editor.decision_json->>'verdict' = 'N'
      AND editor.is_valid
      AND NOT editor.is_shadow
    ORDER BY editor.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS rewrite_instruction ON true
), bindings AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    COALESCE(binding.runtime_bindings, '{}'::jsonb) AS runtime_bindings,
    COALESCE(binding.binding_count, 0)::integer AS binding_count
  FROM audit_context AS c
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      jsonb_object_agg(b.node_code, to_jsonb(b) - 'local_operator_id' ORDER BY b.node_code) AS runtime_bindings,
      count(*)::integer AS binding_count
    FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding AS b
    WHERE b.local_operator_id = c.local_operator_id
      AND b.node_code IN ('FP009-01', 'FP010-01', 'FP011-01', 'FP011-02', 'FP012-01', 'FP013-01')
      AND b.prompt_status = 'active'
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.model_name), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.provider_base_url), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.prompt_text), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(b.api_key_ref), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS binding ON true
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'request', request || jsonb_build_object(
    'local_operator_id', local_operator_id,
    'book_id', scoped_book_id,
    'l1a_unit_id', requested_l1a_unit_id,
    'chapter_id', candidate_chapter_id,
    'chapter_version_id', candidate_version_id,
    'idempotency_key', 'zh06-render-' || md5(COALESCE(NULLIF(request->>'idempotency_key', ''), NULLIF(request->>'base_idempotency_key', ''), '') || ':' || COALESCE(candidate_version_id::text, '') || ':' || COALESCE(objective_attempt_count, 0)::text)
  ),
  'scope', jsonb_build_object(
    'local_operator_id', local_operator_id,
    'book_id', scoped_book_id,
    'l1a_unit_id', requested_l1a_unit_id,
    'chapter_id', candidate_chapter_id,
    'chapter_version_id', candidate_version_id
  ),
  'candidate_ready', scoped_book_id IS NOT NULL
    AND current_chapter_id IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(deduction_locked, false)
    AND candidate_plot_sim_json IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(candidate_truth_ledger_valid, false)
    AND target_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL
    AND chapter_implementation_json IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(ordered_next_candidate, false)
    AND NOT COALESCE(editorial_retry_limit_reached, false),
  'candidate', CASE
    WHEN scoped_book_id IS NOT NULL
      AND current_chapter_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(deduction_locked, false)
      AND candidate_plot_sim_json IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(candidate_truth_ledger_valid, false)
      AND target_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL
      AND chapter_implementation_json IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(ordered_next_candidate, false)
      AND NOT COALESCE(editorial_retry_limit_reached, false)
    THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'book_id', candidate_book_id,
      'chapter_id', candidate_chapter_id,
      'chapter_version_id', candidate_version_id,
      'deduction_locked', deduction_locked,
      'candidate_plot_sim_json', candidate_plot_sim_json,
      'candidate_truth_ledger', candidate_truth_ledger,
      'target_snapshot_json', target_snapshot_json,
      'chapter_implementation_json', chapter_implementation_json,
      'deduction_progress_json', deduction_progress_json,
      'prose_text', prose_text,
      'exception_summary_jsonb', exception_summary_jsonb,
      'world_state_json', world_state_json,
      'character_profiles_json', character_profiles_json,
      'relation_state_json', relation_state_json,
      'formal_state_baseline_json', formal_state_baseline_json,
      'locked_future_l1a_commitments', locked_future_l1a_commitments,
      'book_context', book_context,
      'previous_formal_prose_text', previous_formal_prose_text,
      'return_route_suggestion_jsonb', COALESCE(request->'return_route_suggestion_jsonb', '{}'::jsonb),
      'fix_instruction_json', fix_instruction_json
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  'runtime_bindings', runtime_bindings,
  'binding_count', binding_count,
  'config_ready', binding_count = 6
    AND runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP009-01', 'FP010-01', 'FP011-01', 'FP011-02', 'FP012-01', 'FP013-01'],
  'redacted_error', CASE
    WHEN scoped_book_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED',
      'message', 'The selected book is unavailable.'
    )
    WHEN requested_l1a_unit_id IS NULL
      OR requested_l1a_unit_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_l1a_id THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'SCOPE_REJECTED',
      'message', 'The selected L1A is unavailable.'
    )
    WHEN COALESCE(editorial_retry_limit_reached, false) THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'EDITORIAL_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED',
      'message', 'The third subjective return stopped current chapter production.'
    )
    WHEN current_chapter_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT COALESCE(ordered_next_candidate, false) THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'CHAPTER_ORDER_REJECTED',
      'message', 'Only the current L1A ordered next candidate can start literary presentation.'
    )
    WHEN current_chapter_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT COALESCE(candidate_truth_ledger_valid, false) THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'DEDUCTION_SNAPSHOT_INCOMPLETE',
      'message', 'The locked deduction snapshot is missing a complete candidate truth ledger.'
    )
    WHEN current_chapter_id IS NULL
      OR NOT COALESCE(deduction_locked, false)
      OR candidate_plot_sim_json IS NULL
      OR target_snapshot_json IS NULL
      OR chapter_implementation_json IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'DEDUCTION_NOT_LOCKED',
      'message', 'A current-L1A candidate with locked deduction, target, and implementation snapshots is required before audit processing can start.'
    )
    WHEN binding_count <> 6
      OR NOT (runtime_bindings ?& ARRAY['FP009-01', 'FP010-01', 'FP011-01', 'FP011-02', 'FP012-01', 'FP013-01']) THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'code', 'CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED',
      'message', 'An active model and prompt binding is required before audit processing can start.'
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END
) AS context
FROM bindings;

nodes.name: 读取章节推演结果 plot_sim_json / target_snapshot_json

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const source = $json ?? {}; const context = source.context ?? $('读取章节推演结果 plot_sim_json / target_snapshot_json').first().json.context ?? {}; if (context.candidate_ready !== true) return { ok: false, redacted_error: context.redacted_error ?? { code: 'DEDUCTION_NOT_LOCKED', message: 'A current locked candidate is required before audit processing can start.' } }; const candidate = context.candidate ?? {}; const missing = []; if (!Array.isArray(candidate.world_state_json) || candidate.world_state_json.length === 0) missing.push('formal_initial_world_state'); if (!Array.isArray(candidate.character_profiles_json) || candidate.character_profiles_json.length === 0) missing.push('formal_active_character'); if (missing.length) return { ok: false, redacted_error: { code: 'DATA_DEBT', message: 'Audit processing requires the missing formal source facts.' }, data_debt: missing }; const parserError = typeof source.error === 'string' ? source.error : typeof source.error?.message === 'string' ? source.error.message : ''; if (/^DATA_DEBT\s*:/u.test(parserError)) return { ok: false, redacted_error: { code: 'DATA_DEBT', message: 'Literary presentation requires declared upstream source facts.' } }; if (source.error) return { ok: false, redacted_error: { code: 'AUDIT_WORKFLOW_ERROR', message: 'Audit processing did not complete.' } }; if (source.objective_gate?.has_p0_blocker === true) return { ok: false, redacted_error: { code: 'P0_BLOCKED', message: 'The objective audit blocked this candidate before editorial review.' } }; if (source.decision?.verdict === 'N') return { ok: false, redacted_error: source.decision.force_manual === true ? { code: 'EDITORIAL_RETRY_LIMIT_REACHED', message: 'The third subjective return stopped current chapter production.' } : { code: 'EDITORIAL_REWRITING', message: 'The editor returned this candidate for automatic literary revision.' } }; return { ok: true }; })() }}

'DEDUCTION_NOT_LOCKED') + ': a current locked candidate is required.'); const binding = context.runtime_bindings?.['FP009-01']; if (!binding || typeof binding.model_name !== 'string' || !binding.model_name.trim() || typeof binding.provider_base_url !== 'string' || !binding.provider_base_url.trim() || typeof binding.prompt_text !== 'string' || !binding.prompt_text.trim() || typeof binding.api_key_ref !== 'string' || !binding.api_key_ref.trim()) throw new Error('CONFIG_CONTRACT_BLOCKED: FP009-01 requires an active runtime binding.'); let base = String(binding.provider_base_url); while (base.endsWith('/')) base = base.slice(0, -1); const lower = base.toLowerCase(); return lower.endsWith('/chat/completions') ? base : new RegExp('/v[0-9]+(?:beta)?$', 'i').test(base) ? base + '/chat/completions' : base + '/v1/chat/completions'; })() }}

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload
), persisted AS (
  SELECT public.rpc_persist_candidate_text(payload->'rpc_persist_candidate_text') AS result
  FROM input
), audited AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN persisted.result->>'ok' = 'true'
      THEN public.rpc_confirm_audit_result(input.payload #> '{rpc_requests,rpc_confirm_audit_result}')
    ELSE persisted.result
  END AS result
  FROM input, persisted
), persistence_guard AS (
  SELECT 1 / CASE
    WHEN persisted.result->>'ok' = 'true' AND audited.result->>'ok' = 'true' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS asserted
  FROM persisted, audited
), scope AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,local_operator_id}' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,local_operator_id}')::uuid END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE WHEN payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,book_id}' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,book_id}')::uuid END AS book_id,
    CASE WHEN payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,chapter_id}' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,chapter_id}')::uuid END AS chapter_id,
    CASE WHEN payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,chapter_version_id}' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (payload #>> '{rpc_persist_candidate_text,chapter_version_id}')::uuid END AS chapter_version_id,
    payload #>> '{request,idempotency_key}' AS base_idempotency_key
  FROM input
), candidate AS (
  SELECT h.l1a_unit_id AS l1a_unit_id, cv.target_snapshot_json, cv.deduction_progress_json, cv.exception_summary_jsonb
  FROM scope AS s
  JOIN public.book_project AS bp
    ON bp.id = s.book_id
   AND bp.local_operator_id = s.local_operator_id
  JOIN public.chapter_version AS cv
    ON cv.id = s.chapter_version_id
   AND cv.book_id = s.book_id
   AND cv.chapter_id = s.chapter_id
   AND cv.version_state = 'candidate'
   AND cv.deduction_locked
   AND cv.is_valid
   AND NOT cv.is_shadow
  JOIN public.chapter_header AS h
    ON h.id = s.chapter_id
   AND h.book_id = s.book_id
   AND h.l1a_unit_id = bp.current_l1a_id
   AND NOT h.is_finalized
)
SELECT
  jsonb_build_object(
    'local_operator_id', scope.local_operator_id,
    'book_id', scope.book_id,
    'l1a_unit_id', candidate.l1a_unit_id,
    'chapter_id', scope.chapter_id,
    'chapter_version_id', scope.chapter_version_id
  ) AS scope,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'target_snapshot_json', candidate.target_snapshot_json,
    'deduction_progress_json', candidate.deduction_progress_json,
    'exception_summary_jsonb', candidate.exception_summary_jsonb
  ) AS candidate_context,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'has_p0_blocker', COALESCE((audited.result #>> '{state,has_p0_blocker}')::boolean, true),
    'requires_rewrite', COALESCE((input.payload->>'objective_requires_rewrite')::boolean, true)
  ) AS objective_gate,
  CASE
    WHEN persisted.result->>'ok' = 'true' AND audited.result->>'ok' = 'true' THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS objective_persistence_ok,
  CASE
    WHEN persisted.result->>'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' THEN persisted.result->'error'
    WHEN audited.result->>'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' THEN audited.result->'error'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS objective_persistence_error,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'scope', jsonb_build_object(
      'local_operator_id', scope.local_operator_id,
      'book_id', scope.book_id,
      'l1a_unit_id', candidate.l1a_unit_id,
      'chapter_id', scope.chapter_id,
      'chapter_version_id', scope.chapter_version_id
    ),
    'return_route_suggestion_jsonb', COALESCE(input.payload #> '{objective_audit,return_route_suggestion_jsonb}', '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS rewrite_request,
  persistence_guard.asserted AS persistence_guard,
  scope.base_idempotency_key
FROM input, persisted, audited, scope, persistence_guard
LEFT JOIN candidate ON true;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS envelope
), client AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(envelope->'action', '{}'::jsonb) AS action,
    COALESCE(envelope->'editorial', '{}'::jsonb) AS editorial
  FROM input
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(action->>'action', '') AS action_name,
    NULLIF(btrim(action->>'return_reason'), '') AS return_reason,
    editorial->'scope' AS scope,
    NULLIF(editorial->>'base_idempotency_key', '') AS base_idempotency_key
  FROM client
), routed AS (
  SELECT
    action_name,
    scope,
    base_idempotency_key,
    CASE
      WHEN action_name = 'continue_next_chapter'
       AND jsonb_typeof(scope) = 'object'
       AND public.v7_valid_idempotency_key(base_idempotency_key || ':continue')
      THEN public.rpc_continue_chapter(jsonb_build_object(
        'local_operator_id', scope->>'local_operator_id',
        'book_id', scope->>'book_id',
        'chapter_id', scope->>'chapter_id',
        'chapter_version_id', scope->>'chapter_version_id',
        'idempotency_key', base_idempotency_key || ':continue'
      ))
      WHEN action_name = 'return_current_chapter'
       AND jsonb_typeof(scope) = 'object'
       AND return_reason IS NOT NULL
       AND public.v7_valid_idempotency_key(base_idempotency_key || ':return')
      THEN public.rpc_archive_shadow_version(jsonb_build_object(
        'local_operator_id', scope->>'local_operator_id',
        'book_id', scope->>'book_id',
        'chapter_id', scope->>'chapter_id',
        'chapter_version_id', scope->>'chapter_version_id',
        'return_reason', return_reason,
        'idempotency_key', base_idempotency_key || ':return'
      ))
      WHEN action_name = 'return_current_chapter' THEN public.v7_error(
        'RETURN_INTENT_REJECTED',
        'Returning the current formal chapter requires its scoped non-empty reason.'
      )
      ELSE public.v7_error('CONTINUATION_REJECTED', 'Only a continuation or current-formal-chapter return intent is accepted at this wait route.')
    END AS result
  FROM requested
)
SELECT
  result->>'ok' = 'true' AS confirmation_ok,
  CASE
    WHEN result #>> '{state,next_action}' = 'present_next_chapter' THEN 'continue'
    WHEN result #>> '{state,next_action}' = 'present_rewrite_candidate' THEN 'return'
    WHEN result #>> '{state,next_action}' = 'l1a_complete' THEN 'complete'
    ELSE 'blocked'
  END AS next_action,
  CASE
    WHEN result #>> '{state,next_action}' = 'present_rewrite_candidate' THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'local_operator_id', scope->>'local_operator_id',
      'book_id', scope->>'book_id',
      'l1a_unit_id', scope->>'l1a_unit_id',
      'idempotency_key', base_idempotency_key || ':rewrite'
    )
    ELSE result->'next_presentation_request'
  END AS presentation_request,
  result->'redacted_error' AS redacted_error
FROM routed;
